New #Epstein Files Reveal Email Titled Photo from Visit with Bibi Netanyahu

Jacob Frenkel, who previously served as Governor of the Bank of Israel, sent an email to Jesse Staley, a prominent American banker who held leadership positions in several banks, in which he said
I found this photo from our visit with Bibi #Netanyahu

But the photo was completely redacted by the U.S. Department of Justice.

node.text: Those who are aware of the landowning (zamindara)history of Punjab,also are familiar of the long held and common culture of older brother’s disapproving their younger brothers-forcefully acquiring their land and property.Leaving the other brother with no option but to stay quiet In front of his cruel brother,for multiple reasons sometimes because of the brother is older,sometimes because the brother who is vicitmised is gentlemanly or fragile and is unable to fight.Brothers who have been victims like these have been deprived of their rights for many many years as the brother who is the tyrant  views his sibling as his ‘shareek’( opponent).Same is the case with Yasin Tarragar he is a gentle man who is being victimised from the past 15yrs as his older brother Mr.Sarfraz Taragar has continued to harass him.First it was him now it’s his children who do not care for someone who is older or younger.Mrs Ambreen and Mahnoor have came up with an unknown man now and continue their aggression which unfortunately Yasin is forced to respond to.He shows great restraint but Mr.Sarfraz’s family showed up with goons and an unknown lawyer who initiates fights.Yasin has put up his effort against this toxic culture of the landowning history of Punjab where the victim brother is reduced to nothing and his family and generations are left to ruin.Yasin has daughters at home who also have showed restraint and have not misbehaved with their uncle Mr Sarfraz Tarrgar.Yasin those who know him are aware is a happy go lucky man who is being forced to fight.But he has continue to do so and is a VICTIM of the disregard of his older brother which he has faced from 25 yrs.Mrs Ambreen has never amicably resided with her in laws it is known history,and her children now harbour her legacy of a huge hate-red which Yasin does not deserve.Yasin has a right to existence being the younger one does not mean being reduced to a nobody.Unfortunately these videos are also a forced reaction because Mrs ambreen and Mahnoor continue to show up on media and LIE which the women of Yasin’s family have been avoiding.Mahnoor continues to spread lies against her uncle and is forcing the conflict continuously forth.

What Happened: Israel has appointed a Muslim woman as its Arabic-language military spokesperson for the first time, a move being seen as a notable milestone within the Israeli armed forces.

What you need to know: The Israeli military announced that Major Ella Waweya will take over the role in the coming weeks, replacing Colonel Avichay Adraee, who is set to retire after serving in the position for two decades. With this appointment, Major Waweya will be promoted to the rank of Lieutenant Colonel. At 36, she is widely known on social media as “Captain Ella” and is considered one of the most prominent Muslim Arab women officers in the Israeli military.

What more: Born in the Arab town of Qalansawe in central Israel, Ella Waweya voluntarily enlisted in the army in 2013, initially keeping her decision private from her family. She currently serves as Colonel Adraee’s deputy and has a strong social media presence, with around 500,000 followers on TikTok and nearly 200,000 on X.

What ele: Her appointment is being described as a significant step toward increased representation of Arab citizens, particularly Muslim women, within the Israeli military. While Israel is a Jewish-majority state, nearly 20 percent of its population is made up of Arab citizens, including Muslims, Christians, and Druze. Military service is compulsory for Druze and Circassian communities, while it remains voluntary for Muslim and Christian Arabs, a trend that has seen growing participation in recent years, especially among women.

An evening well spent in the company of fine watchmaking.
We had the pleasure of attending an intimate showcase with the principal of @cuervoysobrinos at @hanifwatches & @hanifjewellers , where he personally introduced the latest collection and shared the heritage behind the brand.

Aden, my wife and I enjoyed trying on some exceptional pieces, each one defined by timeless design, quiet sophistication and remarkable craftsmanship.

A refined gathering, thoughtful conversation and watches that truly speak for themselves.

This isn’t why we should have secure communications and mobile devices. It’s more about having the choice of privacy which I think everyone should be entitled to.

Cut nails, flush, don’t cut at night… she is genuinely questioning her life choices right now 🙈

What do you do with your nails? I just toss em in the trash 🤷

modestclothing  #momblogger #modestfashion #musliminfluencer #muslimblogger
It’s a Muslim thing to flush them

If anyone lives abroad, you SHOULD NOT throw hair or nails in the toilet! 😮 We are taught here in schools, that the only things going into the toilet should be stools, liquid (you know), and toilet paper. Anything else creates lots of problems at the cleaning facility and can block your toilet (like sanitary pads). And if you are worried about jaado joodo...make sure that your guests cannot access the bins in which you throw nails and hair. Don´t make the Deen difficult for yourself.

Remember when Shilpa Shetty was in the U.K Big Brother show, she apparently threw left over FOOD into the toilet!!!! 😨😵 And British people (and Southasians) started thinking that ALL Desi people must be doing so. It´s crazy! The toilet is for toilet things! Kuch toh tameez seekh lo!
What? Is this another thing I should be doing that I know nothing about?? You guys have no idea how complicated it is being a revert to Islam! 😂
Nails kaat kr in ko maati main dafan krna chahiye
Her in law be like " What in the voodoo is this????"
Jo jin dustbin se nikal skte  hyn wo flush se ni nikal skte ? 😂
Throw them in the trashcan saying bismillah.
It’s a Muslim thing to flush them

​تتبع الهوية عبر الشبكة اللاسلكية: اختراق الخصوصية الفيزيائي
​تعتمد شبكات الـ 5G (وتحديداً تقنية ISAC) على تحويل موجات الراديو إلى مجسات رادارية. إليكِ التفاصيل التقنية لكيفية تحديد هويتك الشخصية بدقة دون الحاجة لأي معرف رقمي (SIM/IMEI):
​1. البصمة الرادارية الدقيقة (Micro-Doppler Signature)
​عندما يتحرك جسم الإنسان، فإن كل عضو (اليد، الساق، الجذع) يتحرك بسرعة وزاوية مختلفة بالنسبة لبرج الاتصالات. هذا التفاوت يخلق انعكاسات بترددات متغيرة تُعرف بإزاحة دوپلر الصغرى.
​الخوارزمية: يقوم البرج بجمع هذه الانعكاسات وتحليلها عبر (Short-Time Fourier Transform) لإنشاء مخطط زمني-ترددي فريد يسمى "توقيع دوپلر". هذا التوقيع يمثل بصمة حركية لا تتكرر بين شخصين.
​2. استخراج الهيكل البيومتري (Biometric Skeleton Extraction)
​بفضل طول الموجة القصير جداً في ترددات الـ mmWave، تستطيع الشبكة القيام بعملية (High-resolution Imaging).
​الشبكة لا "تراك" كصورة كاميرا، بل "تستشعر" أبعاد هيكلك العظمي: طول الفخذ، عرض الكتفين، وطريقة توزيع ثقل الجسم أثناء المشي.
​هذه القياسات تُحول إلى "ناقل سمات" (Feature Vector) في قاعدة بيانات الذكاء الاصطناعي التابعة للشبكة.
​3. الربط المتقاطع (Cross-Entity Association)
​هنا تكمن الخدعة؛ النظام لا يحتاج لمعرفة اسمك ابتداءً. هو يقوم بربط "بصمتك الحركية" المسجلة (بينما كان هاتفك معك والـ GPS مفعلاً) مع "البصمة الرادارية" الحالية.
​بمجرد خروجك بدون هاتف، تتعرف الشبكة على النمط الحركي المطابق للملف المخزن سابقاً، وتستمر في تحديث موقعك الجغرافي بناءً على حركة "الجسم المادي" في الفراغ.
​4. التتبع في البيئات الكثيفة (Multi-Object Tracking)
​باستخدام تقنية الـ Beamforming، يستطيع البرج تخصيص حزمة إشارة ضيقة تلاحق جسمك تحديداً (Point-to-Point) وتعزله عن الأجسام المتحركة الأخرى (مثل السيارات أو الأشخاص الآخرين) بناءً على سرعة واتجاه حركتك الفريدة.
​هل يمكن تضليل هذا النظام؟ (Perspective)
​من الناحية التقنية، تضليل الرادار السلبي يتطلب:
​التشويش الفيزيائي: ارتداء مواد تمتص موجات الراديو (RAM - Radar Absorbent Material) لمنع الانعكاس.
​تغيير النمط الحركي: وهو أمر صعب جداً لأن الـ AI يكتشف المحاولات المصطنعة لتغيير المشية (Adversarial Gait

The History behind their worship.

Baal was worshipped by the Canaanites and Phoenicians in the Middle East (modern Israel, Lebanon, Syria). His worship started around 2000 BCE and lasted until about 500 BCE. He was believed to control rain and fertility for crops.

node.text: Cinema varies greatly across countries, each developing distinctive traditions, storytelling approaches, visual styles, and cultural emphases that reflect their societies and histories. The United States, through **Hollywood**, dominates globally with its emphasis on high-production-value blockbusters, narrative-driven genres like action, science fiction, and drama, innovative special effects, and star-centered entertainment that often prioritizes broad appeal and emotional escapism. India stands out for its massive output, particularly through **Bollywood** and regional industries, characterized by vibrant musical sequences, melodramatic plots blending romance, family values, and social themes, elaborate song-and-dance numbers, and a focus on emotional intensity and moral lessons rooted in cultural traditions. France excels in auteur-driven art cinema, known for intellectual depth, experimental techniques, poetic realism, philosophical undertones, and a strong emphasis on character psychology and social commentary, often supported by state funding for creative freedom. Japan contributes profound stylistic innovation through precise visual composition, themes of honor, nature, existentialism, family dynamics, and a masterful blend of live-action and animation traditions that explore human emotions with subtlety and restraint. Italy has given the world influential movements like neorealism, focusing on everyday life, social issues, and authentic locations, alongside operatic grandeur in historical epics and stylish genre works that highlight passion, family, and moral complexity. South Korea has risen prominently with technically polished productions blending intense thrillers, heartfelt dramas, and genre hybrids, often incorporating sharp social critique, family conflicts, and dynamic pacing that resonates universally while staying grounded in local sensibilities. Other notable traditions include Iran's poetic, minimalist approach emphasizing human dignity, censorship navigation, and subtle metaphor; Germany's expressionist roots with dramatic lighting and psychological intensity; Sweden's introspective, atmospheric explorations of existential and moral question

This is not random.
And it never was.

Wars don’t just happen.
Crashes don’t just happen.
Scandals don’t just happen.
The same names, institutions, and narratives don’t keep resurfacing by accident.

We are taught to see history in fragments isolated events, lone villains, unfortunate mistakes.
But when you step back far enough, a pattern emerges that can’t be unseen.

Epstein.
9/11.
Financial crashes.
Wars.
Media narratives.
Political theatre.
Debt.
Surveillance.
Control.

Different stories.
Same structures.

This isn’t about believing everything.
It’s about realising that much of what we’ve been told isn’t true or isn’t complete.

Once you start pulling on the threads, the illusion of coincidence collapses.

If you’re ready to move past surface-level explanations and understand how power actually operates, read the full long-form investigation.

node.text:
📌 Disclaimer on fulfilling his emotional and physical needs:

The Prophet ﷺ said: “If a man calls his wife to his bed, and she refuses without a valid reason, and he remains upset, the angels curse her until morning.”

This highlights the importance of companionship and intimacy in marriage.

The curse applies only if:
	1.	The wife refuses without a valid excuse.
	2.	The husband remains angry as a result.

The statement “The angels curse her until morning”

it applies under two conditions:

if the husband calls her and she refuses without valid reason and he spends the night angry as a result

The term “curse” means being distanced or excluded from Allah’s mercy.

When creatures invoke a curse, they are essentially appealing for the one being cursed to be barred from divine mercy.

Thus, the angels’ curse remains until the morning.

1. In 2021, a Harvard psychologist surprised a lecture hall with an unexpected statement:

“If you haven’t accomplished much by 25, you may have escaped one of youth’s biggest illusions.”

At first, the room laughed.
He wasn’t kidding.
	
2. The illusion of early success.

In your early 20s, the brain seeks quick proof of worth — status, attention, rapid achievements.

But psychologists warn that chasing recognition too soon can lock people into roles or paths they never consciously chose.

They decide too early… and spend years trying to undo it.
	
3. The exploration phase.

Research on career development suggests that people who explore more before 30 often build stronger long-term directions.

Testing ideas.
Making mistakes in public.
Changing course.

At 25 it looks like confusion — but by 35 it often turns into clarity.
	
4. The quiet advantage.

People who feel “behind” in their mid-20s frequently gain something others miss:

Perspective.
Patience.
And a clearer sense of what truly matters to them.

That foundation often leads to better decisions later on.
	
5. The hidden truth.

At the end of the lecture, the psychologist left the students with one final thought:

“You’re not meant to have life fully figured out at 25.”

“You’re meant to discover who you’re not.”

And strangely enough…
that moment is often where real success begins. ✨

——

We are creating a space for those ready to shed the roles they’ve been playing —
to stop living life for others’ expectations,
and reconnect with the essence of who they truly are,
the part of themselves that has been hidden under fear and self-protection.

If this calls to you, comment “MASK” below and I will send you your first step toward clarity.

Join us at @your.unmasking.process and stay close as this space unfolds.

This $20 game is solving a $600B problem.
Data centers need 650,000 workers this year.
58% cannot find qualified talent.
Hiring timelines have doubled.
AWS, Google, and Microsoft are spending $600B+ on infrastructure. But racks, cooling, power redundancy, and network topology do not run themselves.
One solo developer built a game where you place servers in racks, route Ethernet manually, visualize packet bottlenecks, and learn redundancy by breaking things.
The game is set to release on Steam on 31st of March - Data Center
.
.
.

The most debated verse, and here’s my perspective! I was inspired to make this. So take it or leave it, but don’t spread hate, thanks. 🫶🏼

May Allah forgive me for any mistakes or misinterpretations. He knows best and may He open our hearts toward the truth. Keep me in your prayers during these last nights of Ramadan. 🤲🏼

Sure. But what when the husband is rebelling? Is the wife given the right to discipline and beat him? 
When;
1) He rebels and disrespects?
2) He says no to being intimate (do angels curse the husband as well?) 
3) When he married another since he doesn't need to ask the first wife for a second marriage according to shariah?
Islam wouldn't be the best religion if this ayah meant to hit women, so it's simple.

node.text: If you call Israel your ‘fatherland’, remember that cows are not eaten anywhere in Iran, but in Israel there is hardly a table where beef is not served,” says Maulana Kalbe Jawwad Shia cleric Kalbe Jawwad has criticised people expressing support for Israel during the ongoing conflict, questioning what he described as contradictions in their claims of reverence for cows. In a video statement, Jawwad said that while rituals are being performed in some places for Israel’s victory, those praising Israel should note that cows are not eaten across Iran, whereas beef is widely consumed in Israel. He questioned why people who consider the cow sacred would call such a country their “fatherland”.

PM Modi specifically referenced Indian Jews, stating, "They hold firmly that Israel is their fatherland and India their motherland". This phrase was intended for the approximately 85,000-strong Indian-Jewish diaspora in Israel😡😡😡😡

node.text: @gfffhdhdjsje وړومبي خو دي پښتو زده که، ځلپاني ترور، بيا به سره قيصه کو. دویمه خبره ده ده، چې په دغه پنجاب کۍ خو زه هم پاتې کیږم، او خو په نره په خپل افغانیت او پښتو ولاړ یم، ماته خو چې څه هم ونویل. چې څوک خپله په خپله پښتو ماین وي، هغه ده بل قام ده وېرې خپله پښتو نه پریږدي.

node.text: We'll offer you an internship with 20K stipend, no perks or benefits, it won't even convert into a full time role 😂 Sasta mazdor chahye inko for 3 months
No pakwheel is offended in this video 👏🏼
Unfortunately every boss with multi million assets and business says the same in Pakistan 😂

🔥 Gen Z Pakistan — Enough Is Enough 🇵🇰
People are struggling.
Students are suffering.
Respect is fading.
A broken system that doesn’t protect its people
needs to change.
Look at Nepal — people stood up,
and things started to shift.
We don’t stay silent anymore.
We raise our voice, we demand better,
and we build a system that respects us. ⚡

The video unveils the hidden truth behind the birth of the European Renaissance and the systematic rebranding of the Islamic Golden Age. For exactly 508 years, between 750 CE and 1258 CE, the Muslim world was the undisputed global leader in science, medicine, and philosophy. 

While Europe struggled through the Dark Ages, centers of learning like the House of Wisdom preserved and perfected the world’s knowledge. This video reveals the tactical translation movement in Toledo where the West stole Islamic science by Latinizing names to hide their true origins. We explore how legendary scholars like Ibn Sina were transformed into Avicenna and Al-Khwarizmi became Algoritmi to make modern people believe these contributions were Western. 

Discover how the Islamic Golden Age directly built the foundations of modern mathematics, optics, and chemistry only to be erased from history books. It is time to uncover this grand deception and reclaim the 1,000 years of progress that were hijacked and renamed. Join us as we acknowledge the true architects of modern civilization.

node.text: Optuna or gridsearch cv did something like hyperparameter tuning way before right how is it different?

you have missed the important point in your video, running agent on a particular task is not enough. You must ran parallel against multiple GPus, then you will find the agent experiment out of box strategies and research oriented experiments. 

You won’t see results on single GPUS, I highly doubt that
Mlflow does this with model versioning.. is this real a new concept?
Optuna or gridsearch cv did something like hyperparameter tuning way before right how is it different?

node.text: Adnan Siddiqui has responded to the resurfaced clip of Firdous Jamal discussing Mahira Khan and Humayun Saeed. While acknowledging Firdous Jamal as a remarkable actor, he emphasized that an actor’s stardom ultimately comes from the audience, and such remarks about fellow actors are not justified. #AdnanSiddiqui #FirdousJamal #MahiraKhan #HumayunSaeed ( 📷: YT/RTS with 24 plus)
He is perfectly right.... Mahira ko zra bhi acting ni ati bs bachi banna ata e

Haye Allah! What's the point of bringing up these videos over and over again? I know and understand exactly what he is saying, he's just not saying it in the right manner/ using proper wording! He also needs to leave things be! The audience is getting catered for, at the same time no one is willing to invest in young talent, there's hardly any films getting made in Pakistan anyway, it's just a total mess! I feel the audience is clueless as well, there just as confused as to what they wanna watch, so they just sit and keep accepting these older stars, and the movies they make, instead of making other movies a hit! Just like they comfortably sit and allow a corrupt regime lead their country while a great, innocent leader is behind bars! #releaseimrankhannow ##imrankhanprimeminister #imrankhanforpeace #wakeuppakistan #saynotocorruption #saynotocorruptleaders #saynotoopression #getimrankhanoutofjail #freepalestine🇵🇸 #freehumanity

🇯🇵 1,300 km/h. On land. Not a plane. A train. 🚄💨 Blink... and the city is gone. This simulation imagines Japan pushing rail technology beyond anything we know - past 320 km/h Shinkansen speeds... beyond 600 km/h maglev tests... into true Mach-level travel. 🚀 At this speed, air becomes the enemy. Even the smallest vibration turns into a massive force. To make it possible, engineers explore: ⚡ Magnetic levitation ⚡ Near-zero friction systems ⚡ Low-pressure or vacuum tubes ⚡ AI precision control measured in millimeters. If achieved, hours would turn into minutes. Distance would lose meaning. Cities would feel closer than ever before. This isn’t just transportation. It’s the future of movement.

في رمضان، أكثر شي أؤمن فيه هو إن أبسط مساهمة ممكن تفتح باب كبير لطفل وتغيّر بداية سنة كاملة 🤍

لهذا السبب دعمي لهالمبادرة قريب جداً من قلبي. بالتعاون بين @DubaiCares و @OKXmena، الهدف هو توفير 10,000 حقيبة مدرسية للأطفال من الأسر ذات الدخل المحدود، لأن التعليم يظل من أجمل وأهم أشكال العطاء.

إذا حابين تكونون جزء من هالخير، تقدرون تدعمون الحملة من خلال الرابط:
https://okx.com/en-ae/campaigns/dubai-cares-ramadan

@okx_mena @dubaicares
U have to be covered ok

The Diplomatic Enclave is a highly secure area located in Sector G-5 of Islamabad. It is the main zone where foreign countries keep their embassies, high commissions, and diplomatic offices in Pakistan.

The Diplomatic Enclave was established in the 1960s when Islamabad was being developed as the new capital of Pakistan. During its planning, the government reserved about 56 plots specifically for diplomatic missions so that foreign embassies could be located in one safe and organized area. ￼

Today, the enclave contains around 43 embassies and high commissions of different countries. The area is heavily guarded and public access is restricted, meaning people can only enter with a special pass or official permission. ￼

Because many important diplomatic missions are located there—such as the United States, China, Germany, and other countries—it is considered one of the most secure zones in Islamabad and plays an important role in Pakistan’s international relations.#secretariatislamabad #sipcoffee #foryou #diplomaticenclaveislamabad

👩‍🦰 over 👩‍🦳 

Game of Thrones (2011–2019) is a globally recognized HBO television series created by David Benioff and D. B. Weiss, based on the novel series A Song of Ice and Fire by George R. R. Martin. The show features one of the largest ensemble casts in television history, including Emilia Clarke (Daenerys Targaryen), Kit Harington (Jon Snow), Peter Dinklage (Tyrion Lannister), Lena Headey (Cersei Lannister), Nikolaj Coster-Waldau (Jaime Lannister), Sophie Turner (Sansa Stark), Maisie Williams (Arya Stark), Isaac Hempstead Wright (Bran Stark), Sean Bean (Ned Stark), Charles Dance (Tywin Lannister), Alfie Allen (Theon Greyjoy), Gwendoline Christie (Brienne of Tarth), Jason Momoa (Khal Drogo), and Pedro Pascal (Oberyn Martell).

The series became a worldwide phenomenon, earning multiple Emmy Awards and breaking viewership records throughout its eight-season run. Known for its large-scale production, iconic characters, and cultural impact, Game of Thrones remains one of the most talked-about television shows in history. It later expanded into the franchise House of the Dragon, further growing its global audience.

With its massive cast, high production value, and lasting popularity across streaming platforms and social media, Game of Thrones continues to trend through edits, clips, and fan discussions, standing alongside other legendary TV series in global entertainment history.

Get ratings @umax.app [follow @ascend.maxx ]
. 
. 
. 
Blackpill (in the looksmaxxing context) is an online ideology that says a person’s life outcomes, especially dating and social respect, are mainly determined by genetics and physical appearance like facial structure and height, with self improvement having very limited impact beyond a fixed “genetic ceiling.” Followers often believe traits such as confidence, personality, fitness, or grooming do not significantly change how others perceive you if your base looks are low. In looksmaxxing spaces, blackpill ideas appear through terms like “Chad,” “mogging,” and looks ratings, often spread through dark humor memes and reels. Although looks do matter in first impressions, the blackpill view is widely criticized for being overly negative and harmful, especially for teenagers, as it can damage self esteem and ignore the real influence of mindset, health, effort, and social skills over time.
. 
. 
.

node.text:
A video posted on Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s X account is being seen as his response to the rumours of his death, which were earlier debunked by his office.

The video was posted on Sunday evening, in which Netanyahu is seen getting himself a coffee and being asked about the rumours, Israeli news website Jerusalem Post reported.

The post also had a caption stating: “They say I am what?”

For more, visit the link in our bio.

node.text:
Legacy is built on truth Hamza not on silence. 
#ideasthatchangetheworld #theatheismdelusion #ahmedalhassan #truth #ahlulbayt

"Ya Allah… I keep seeing more and more profiles popping up promoting Ahmed Alhasan as the 'Savior of Mankind,' the new divine messenger, the Yamani, successor to the 12th Imam… and wallahi my heart just breaks every single time 😭
Sisters and brothers, after our Prophet Muhammad ﷺ (peace and blessings be upon him) there is NO new messenger. The Quran is clear — he is the seal of the prophets. But these pages, videos, and books (like Atheism Delusion) are mixing science with 'revelations' to 'correct' Islam and refute our mainstream scholars… it’s all scripted to look modern and innocent, but it’s straight-up fitnah trying to pull people away from the pure deen we already have.
Whether it’s little kids or grown-ups being used to spread this, it’s so deeply disturbing. No one should be turning innocent voices into tools for something that goes against the finality of Prophethood.
May Allah protect our ummah from this deviation, guide every single person promoting it back to the straight path, and open their hearts to the truth of Islam as it was revealed. Ameen ya Rabb 💔 This is enough for us — Islam is enough.
#IslamIsEnough #ProtectOurDeen #MayAllahGuideThem"

node.text:
Most people think confidence comes from being chosen.
But real change happens when you start choosing yourself first. The more you invest in your growth, your peace, your boundaries, and your purpose, the more you quietly teach the world how to treat you.
Focus on you, until the focus naturally finds its way back to you.

If this resonated with you, save this for the days you forget your own worth, and share it with someone who needs the reminder today.

#MentalHealth #SelfWorth #HealingJourney #TherapyTalk #ChooseYourself

Eid Mubarak 🤍
May we continue to grow, may Allah beautify our character and purify our hearts, may every opressed people be free, may we recognise that Allah is all we need, may we set up dreams and goals not only for the Dunja but even more for the Akhira, may we be aware of our deeds and our power, may we live like death is the finish line and may we meet in Djanna. Allahumma Ameen 🤲🏼

The Art Of ‘Early’ Instagram.

When Instagram Launched In 2010, The Feed Felt More Authentic. People Shared Everyday Moments Like Selfies, Meals, And Random Things They Found Online, Similar To Personal Blogs At The Time. That’s What Originally Drew People In, Especially When Following Celebrities, Because For The First Time You Could See What They Were Actually Up To On A Daily Basis.

Just Last Week, Instagram Head Adam Mosseri Said “The Feed Is Dead,” Explaining That Most Personal Moments Are No Longer Shared Publicly, But Instead Through Private Dms And Close Friends Stories.

João Marinho Neto, born on October  in Maranguape, Brazil, is currently recognized as the world’s oldest verified living man at years old. A lifelong farmer, João began working in the fields at age four and raised seven children over two marriages. Now living in a care home in Apuiarés, Ceará, he remains mentally alert despite being blind and hard of hearing. He attributes his long life to staying close to good people and family. In , he was officially confirmed by Guinness World Records as the world’s oldest living man and received the Longev iQuest World’s Oldest M..

Her remarks revisit a pivotal chapter in Pakistan’s diplomatic history, highlighting Zardari’s stance on foreign military presence and national sovereignty.

Producer Umer Mukhtar threatened legal action against Mahnoor Rahim on Friday, a content creator who publicly accused him of messaging her inappropriately. His public statement in the form of a legal notice shared to Instagram comes after Rahim posted two videos, including one highlighting his close friendship with actor Hania Aamir.

On Tuesday, Rahim posted a reel to her Instagram page, saying an unnamed senior producer at a TV channel had sent her messages at 3am in 2023. She said she initially thought it was work-related, and responded, asking why he had messaged her, to which he said he wanted to “chit chat”. She said she then went to his page where she saw he was married, and messaged him, telling him he should be ashamed to be messaging her on Instagram as a married man. She claimed he responded that he was not married. Rahim said she then found his wife’s Instagram page and sent her a screenshot of the conversation.

In a followup reel on Thursday, the content creator named Mukhtar and said he was friends with Aamir, who serves as UN Women’s National Goodwill Ambassador in Pakistan. She claimed to have received messages from many girls making similar allegations against Mukhtar, with screenshots, and questioned how Aamir could fight for women’s rights when she was “besties with a man who is exploiting underage girls” and “preys on underage girls”. “The whole point of this reel is to protect yourself, because no one is going to do it for you,” she said.

Aamir shared a story to her Instagram page on Friday, distancing herself from the situation after her name had been mentioned in “online conversations regarding a situation [she] had no knowledge of or involvement in”. She did not name Mukhtar in her post. Aamir said she had a “zero-tolerance stance towards harassment, exploitation and any conduct that compromises the safety and dignity of women and girls”.

Read more on Images - link in bio.

One of the greatest neurological discoveries of the last decade can save your relationship.

Scientists found out that we have a cell called the “mirror neuron”.

Basically, it is responsible for imitating gestures, yawns, learning some skills through mimicry.

But here’s the most interesting part: if you are in contact with someone that is really stressed, it is very possible that your mirror neurons... will mirror that feeling!

You heard it right: you absorb for yourself what the other feels and is going through.

The same goes for positive things (such as enthusiasm, optimism).

And what does that have to do with relationships, with dating?

Well, if you are with someone that constantly lives with stress and that person doesn’t want to improve that, you need to know that it is very likely that your biography will be written with the pen of stress, in case you marry with them.

If there are a lot of childish melancholy and disregard/denial about this issue, you will probably be contaminated.

The mirror neuron exists.

Don’t fall for the fallacy that you can “save” someone. It is very unlikely. Even more so if it is someone that does NOT want to change. Take this into account in the choice of your partner.

Making a good choice in dating can help to build a solid marriage. Having a solid marriage helps having a happy life. Follow for more tips. ♥️🕵️‍♂️

The park was never meant to witness something like this…

In Love Story 2026, the fight between Carolyn and John is pure emotional chaos. What begins as a heated argument quickly spirals into a raw, explosive confrontation. Years of unspoken pain, jealousy, and heartbreak pour out in every word, every shove, every tear-filled stare.

Carolyn stands her ground, her voice shaking but strong. John’s frustration finally breaks through his silence. The tension between them is intense — not just anger, but love that’s been pushed to its limit.

This isn’t just a fight. It’s the moment their love story either falls apart… or changes forever.
RELATIONSHIP N MARRIAGE IS THE SHITTIEST THING IN THIS WORLD
He is so toxic I will die on that hill

Eles se amavam tanto, o amor aí era muito real, eles só não sabiam lidar com as situações de estresse e ciúmes, o que é normal em um relacionamento saudável. Claro que nada é perfeito porque as pessoas NÃO SÃO PERFEITAS. o que nunca pode acontecer em um casamento é disputa, disputa por posição, Deus fez o homem e mulher para andarem lado a lado como companheiros sendo um o alicerce do outro e Deus o alicerce de ambos. A disputa por espaço na vida do outro, a disputa profissional dentro de um casamento de se achar importante acima do outro que faz com que o casamento desmorona. Por isso o dinheiro deve ser empregado para o crescimento não para o status de importância dentro do casamento, no circulo de amigos e familiar. Um casamento feliz é crescimento espiritual e de ambos como companheiros e indivíduos. É o que eu vejo, na minha opinião.
What y’all fighting about tho I need the tea
This is the equivalent to "jo it's no use jo– "
He is so toxic I will die on that hill

Some research from psychology labs has found that when men and women are friends, men often feel more romantic or se*ual attraction toward their female friends than women do toward male friends. This doesn’t mean every friendship fails, but it does mean the experience isn’t always “just friends” for both sides equally. 

A classic study by Bleske and Buss showed that men tend to perceive opposite-sex friendships differently than women, often linking them with mating potential, and this can shape how friendships evolve over time. 

So the science suggests it’s not that the friendships are impossible, but that underlying attraction and different psychological dynamics often make being “just friends” more complex than we think.

2026 is not about “using AI.”
It’s about understanding the AI stack.

Most people learn tools.
Very few learn systems.

Here’s what actually matters:

• Prompt Engineering — turning generic output into executable strategy
• AI Agents — systems that complete tasks, not just reply
• Workflow Automation — connecting tools so work runs without you
• Agentic Agents — planning, adapting, self-correcting
• Multimodal AI — text, image, audio, code in one flow
• RAG — grounding AI in your own data
• AEO / GEO — optimizing to appear inside AI-generated answers
• AI Tool Stacking — building one integrated system instead of scattered apps
• LLM Management — controlling cost, performance, and ROI

The shift is clear:

We’re moving from chatting with AI
to architecting AI-driven operations.

If AI becomes core infrastructure in your career or business,
these aren’t “nice to know” skills — they’re leverage.

Save this. Build the stack.

Day 4 — Backbiting (الغِيبَة)

Allah says: “Do not backbite one another…” (Qur’an 49:12)

The Prophet ﷺ defined it: mentioning your brother in a way he dislikes—even if it’s true. (Muslim 2589)

When is “negative talk” allowed? (only as needed):
• to get serious advice / help to solve an interpersonal issue (istiftā’/seeking help)
• about a public sinner who openly publicizes wrongdoing
• about a tyrannical ruler / oppression (complaint to stop harm)

Warnings (don’t take this lightly):
• Allah may expose the fault-hunter’s sins in this life (Ibn Mājah 2546; Abū Dāwūd 4880)
• Bankruptcy on Qiyāmah: deeds taken and given to victims (Muslim 2581)
• Miʿrāj scene: people scratching faces/chests with copper nails for violating honor / “eating people’s flesh” (Abū Dāwūd 4878)
• Punishment in the grave for malicious gossip that spreads harm (Bukhārī 216)

RESET: PAUSE → STOP → SWITCH to duʿā → DEFEND: “Let’s not talk about them.” → REPAIR: repent & seek the person’s forgiveness if you wronged them. #allah #sunnah #quranicpsychology #ramadan
Assalamu alykum look out for the new post for REPLACE inshaAllah!
May Allah the merciful forgive our minor and major sins

Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar has said Pakistan contacted Iran and reminded it of the defense agreement with Saudi Arabia, urging Tehran not to target the Kingdom. Speaking at a press conference, Dar stated that Iran informed Pakistan it was striking US bases in response to American and Israeli attacks, but airport facilities in Gulf countries were also hit. He stressed that Pakistan does not want to be dragged into the escalating conflict and would have raised a stronger joint voice against the US and Israel had Gulf states not been targeted. Dar added that Pakistan issued its condemnation within 15 minutes, while acknowledging the complexities of resistance in the region.

هجوم Simjacker يعتمد على استغلال منطق موجود داخل شريحة الهاتف نفسها. بعض شرائح SIM تحتوي تطبيقًا يسمى S@T Browser وهو جزء من نظام SIM Toolkit الذي يسمح للشريحة بتنفيذ أوامر قادمة من الشبكة. هذه الأوامر تُرسل عادة عبر رسائل SMS خاصة تُسمى رسائل OTA، وهي رسائل لا تظهر للمستخدم لأنها تُعالج مباشرة داخل الشريحة.
عندما يرسل المهاجم رسالة مصممة بطريقة معينة، تقوم الشريحة بقراءتها كأمر وليس كرسالة عادية. إذا احتوت الرسالة على تعليمات SIM Toolkit يمكن للشريحة تنفيذها تلقائيًا، مثل طلب معلومات من الهاتف أو من الشبكة. بعد تنفيذ الأمر تستطيع الشريحة إرسال رسالة SMS أخرى بشكل مخفي تحتوي البيانات التي تم جمعها.
بهذه الطريقة يمكن استخدام الهجوم للحصول على معلومات مثل موقع الهاتف التقريبي عبر الشبكة، رقم الجهاز (IMEI)، رقم الشريحة (IMSI)، أو معلومات عن الشبكة التي يتصل بها الهاتف. وفي بعض الحالات يمكن إرسال هذه الرسائل عدة مرات لمتابعة موقع الجهاز أو جمع معلومات إضافية مع الوقت.
خطورة هذا النوع من الهجمات أنه يحدث بدون أي تفاعل من المستخدم. لا تظهر رسالة في الهاتف ولا إشعار، لأن المعالجة تتم داخل شريحة SIM نفسها. لذلك كان هذا الأسلوب يُستخدم أحيانًا في عمليات المراقبة والتتبع، حيث يمكن جمع معلومات من الجهاز عبر رسائل مخفية تعمل في طبقة الشبكة وليس في نظام الهاتف.

Your cortisol adjusts.
Your dopamine resets.
Then Iftar comes…
And you overload sugar, fried food, and instant pleasure.
That’s not recovery.
That’s undoing the training.
Break your fast with intention.
Not emotion.

.

node.text:
Not just guns and generals -- but businesses, boardrooms, and billions.

Military Inc. exposes how Pakistan’s military expanded beyond defense into a vast corporate empire, controlling industries from real estate to banking.
It argues that this “military capital” entrenches political dominance and reshapes state institutions to protect its economic interests.
A chilling account of how power, profit, and policy become indistinguishable.

Blackrock is literary ran by a Jew named Larry Fink. One of the earliest international banking systems was actually created by the Knight’s Templar. A century later the Medici family rose to prominence and was the most powerful banking families, not the Huguenots. And of course you didn’t deny the existence of Rothschilds or their power and influence, you only changed the goalposts. The Knight Templars were wrongfully stripped of the wealth they had accumulated by a greedy King Philip IV. The Knights had individually taken a vow of poverty even though their organisation was rich. They mostly dealt with the rich and powerful, not the poor, and the people who ultimately “feared” them most were kings, not peasants. They were among the best financial operators of the medieval world. On the other hand, the Medici family literally shaped civilisation. Without them we would not have Michelangelo or Leonardo Da Vinci. But the Rothschilds built a larger, more durable financial empire. While the Medici family were pioneers and cultural powerhouses, the Rothschilds were financing wars and putting governments in crippling debt through bonds. The Medici family (even Templars) didn’t charge interests because usury is a sin in Christianity. The Medicis and similar Christian bankers frequently reinvested their wealth into their communities, sponsoring art, architecture, and public works that benefited broader society. Their banking practices generally aligned with Christian principles of charity and social responsibility. And then we have Hitler. He literally made Germany the envy of Europe within 12 years after kicking out the Rothschilds and getting rid of Jewish influence.

Want to run LLMs locally but don't know what your hardware can handle? llmfit right-sizes models to your system. Terminal tool detects RAM, CPU, GPU, VRAM and compares against a database of thirty-three popular models—tells you exactly which ones will run. Run llmfit. Interactive TUI shows system specs, scrollable model table sorted by compatibility. Hardware detection reads RAM via sysinfo, counts CPU cores.

https://github.com/AlexsJones/llmfit
